supported: single-task imperative inputs with explicit metadata clauses
priority/status/duration/tag extraction from short deterministic patterns
project clauses like "for Project Atlas" or "in project Helios"
assignee clauses like "to Sara", "with Nina and Omar", and @mentions
one-off due_date and due_time spans for common phrases
recurrence plus basic recurrence_start, recurrence_end, and recurrence_exception spans
unsupported: automatic date resolution or rescheduling from free text
broad person-vs-project disambiguation without strong clause cues

cases.name: reference_recurring_exception
cases.text: Submit report to Sara every tuesday except the second tuesday of every month starting today till 24th August with Highpriorty by 10 AM

recurrence_exception.raw: except the second tuesday of every month

cases.notes: This is the main recurring-task target: recurrence stays as surface spans and clock time stays in due_time.

cases.name: reference_imperative_project_assignees
cases.text: finally finish the Q2 board deck draft for Project Atlas with Nina and Omar by the first business day next month, high priority, 90 minutes, in progress, tags #finance #board

expect.title: finally finish the Q2 board deck draft
